lines.trans: Sister Xingzi, have you heard about what happened at the company?
Which one do you mean, the boss deleting a master cut or you calling the police on your own?
Kaiwen and I took leave so the boss could rest for a couple of days too.
I went to the office, and I could not find him anywhere.
He has already resigned.
Why make him resign? Xingtian cannot do without him!
I would rather know what happened between you and the boss while we were away.
I did something terribly wrong.
I confessed my feelings at the wrong time and argued loudly with him in the wrong place.
Even though it happened only yesterday, I feel like a primitive creature.
I hope you carry yourself with maturity from now on.
I will never indulge my impulses like that again; without Mr Chun Yuqiao, Xingtian would not be where it is today.
